title: jmri-json-roster-client-message
description: Schema data object in message from client to JMRI for type "roster". All properties are optional filters; an entry must match every filter present to be returned.

group.description: If present, only return entries in this rosterGroup

road.description: If present, only return entries with this road name

number.description: If present, only return entries with this road number

address.description: If present, only return entries with this DCC address

mfg.description: If present, only return entries with this manufacturer

decoderModel.description: If present, only return entries with this decoder model

decoderFamily.description: If present, only return entries with this decoder family

name.description: If present, only return entries with this identity
